cmd.acceptance.short: Qinisekisa amarekhodi okwamukelwa kokutshalwa nokululama angaguquki
cmd.apply.short: Hlola kuqala bese uqalisa ama-artifact esiteji akhiqiziwe noma abuyekeziwe
cmd.bundle.short: Yakha futhi uqinisekise okuqukethwe kokulawula okunezinguqulo ngokuzimela
cmd.collector_rbac.short: Bonisa ubunikazi bomqoqi be-namespace obubuyekeziwe; izimvume zefu zihlala zingaphandle
cmd.compliance.export.short: Landa futhi uqinisekise ingobo yomlando yobufakazi
cmd.compliance.history.short: Qinisekisa bese uphrinta umjikelezo wempilo wokutholiwe ongaguquki, kusukela kokusha kuqala
cmd.compliance.ingest_falco.short: Guqula umcimbi we-Falco ube yi-manifest ye-Finding ehleliwe ukuze ifakwe ngokubuyekezwa
cmd.compliance.remediation.short: Phrinta iziphakamiso zokulungisa ze-GitOps zokutholiwe okungaxazululiwe
cmd.compliance.status.short: Phrinta amaphrofayela, okutholiwe, nobusha bokucwaningwa kwamabhuku njenge-JSON
cmd.diff.short: Qhathanisa izinhla ezimbili ezilondoloziwe ungaxhumekile ku-inthanethi ngaphandle kokuhlanganisa kabusha
cmd.exception.short: Vumela izibuyekezo zokuhlukile ezibuyekeziwe usebenzisa ukugunyaza kwe-Kubernetes
cmd.fleet.replay.short: Yakha kabusha i-metadata efakwe ku-indeksi kusuka kuzinkomba zejenali ezingaguquki neziqinisekisiwe
cmd.fleet.short: Buza noma udlale kabusha i-metadata ngobunikazi be-mTLS obubhalisiwe
cmd.oscal.import.short: Dala uhlaka olusha lwe-framework olungamephiwe kusuka kukhathalogi ye-OSCAL
cmd.oscal.short: Shintshisana ngamakhathalogi okulawula; ukumepha kokuphoqelela kudinga ukubuyekezwa okuhlukile
cmd.plan.short: Hlanganisa, londoloza noma uqhathanise ama-artifact esiteji ungaxhumekile ku-inthanethi
cmd.status.short: Buka izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhiqiziwe nezibalo zemibiko yenqubomgomo
cmd.status_wait.short: Linda izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhiqiziwe zivumelaniswe futhi ziphile kahle
cmd.validate_clouds.short: Qinisekisa izinkontileka ze-AWS/GCP/Azure ezingaguquki ngaphandle kokulungiselela
cmd.verify.short: Qinisekisa ama-hash ama-artifact alondoloziwe ungaxhumekile ku-inthanethi ngaphandle kokuwasebenzisa
flag.lang: Ulimi lokubonisa (i-BCP-47 noma i-POSIX locale, isib. de, ja, pt-BR)
flag.source_dir: Uhla lwemibhalo lomthombo we-Mantl lwamapulani engqalasizinda
root.long:
I-Mantl ithatha imininingwane yesiteji echazayo bese iyihlanganisa ibe
yingqalasizinda, i-topology ye-GitOps, nezinqubomgomo zokuthobela.
root.short: I-Mantl iyisihlanganisi nesikhathi sokusebenza sesiteji esisekelwe kumininingwane
